**Valmont depot handover**

Established: 62 vehicles, 140 drivers, 8 lifts, 410 daily departures, 530 winter peak, 1.8% cancellations, 1100 parts line items. Certified June 2023; renewal due June 2028. Ops lead: Halvard Onstad. Night supervisor: Teodora Blaskovic. Parts supplier account manager: Ingrid Solheim.

Decided: electrification study approved (unfunded); second charging bay Q3; parts contract renegotiated Nov 2025; training curriculum revised Apr 2026.

Failed/fixed: Feb 2025 brake line failure grounded 9 vehicles 4 days; cause unestablished. Sept 2024 fuel card cloning lost €4200.

Planned: night shift staffing; ticketing terminal replacement on 3 routes.

Open: winter peak capacity unmodelled.

Rules: brake check every 6000 km; fuel card second approval above €200; part above €500 needs two quotations; route change 7 days' notice; incident report within 24 hours; roster single named publisher; driver training 11 days.
